title: number 1 tip for job seekers
description:
Mike's number 1 tip for job seekers?

Its not a race 
or a numbers game 
It's to FOCUS your search for better results 

#jobseeking #jobhunt #jobtips #newjob
transcript: [Music] what's your number one tip for job Seekers you need to focus your job search as much as we want to call it a numbers game it is not just a race to see who can send the most applications in find the roles and the companies that make sense for you
